lines.en: You know, if you came up to me and forced me to choose only one subject to be able to teach for the rest of my life-
I would probably choose none of them.
Teaching sucks.
But, in the event that I'd, for some reason, be unable to forfeit the profession, I think I’d have to go with gym.

Sure, there are plenty of people who view physical education as the ground floor of this field but, when you really think about the day to day lives of people in that specific line of work, wouldn't you say they've got it pretty good?
Look at me. I'm resigned to only one period per day in the gym and I'm ecstatic about the amount of form fitting clothing and exposed skin I get to see. Imagine I got to do this full time?
I wonder if the impact would ever lessen.
Plus, if I was a gym teacher, I'd never have to actually worry about the whole teaching part of the job and could just...make girls do squats all day or something.
I guess what I'm getting at is that this period is one of the few things keeping me attached to this job and-
: Sensei! Over here!
And speaking of attachment, it looks like I'm going to be spending today's physical education class with none other than Ayane Amamiya.
: What are you doing?
: What am I doing? Just waiting for my favorite teacher in the whole wide world to realize that I'm all by myself so he feels inclined to spend time with me.
: Well, it worked. But if anyone asks, I guess just tell them you're not feeling well or something because there is no way this isn't going to stick out to the other girls.
: Sensei! You would have me lie to my friends? Just what kind of girl do you think I am?
: The kind who had no problem designing her entire gym period around manipulating me into talking to her.
: Since when is carefully plotting my actions for the sole purpose of getting you to act in a certain way manipulation?!
: That is quite literally what manipulation is.
: Well, in my book, we call that love.
: Besides, I'm not really in the mood to run right now anyway.
: And why is that, Ayane?
: Well...uhh...
: This is the part where you answer my question.
: I was kind of hoping it was the part where you put two and two together and realize why I might want to be with you right now...
: Ayane, we can literally see the entire class from here.
: Not all of them! Yumi's not here today!
: Oh, right. I forget she counts as a student sometimes.
: What do you expect me to do about this, though? Go fuck you in the storage room while everyone else...exercises or something?
: Umm...maybe?...
: Ayane, come on.
: No, you come on...me!
: Congratulations on throwing away any chance you have at persuading me. I hope your play on words was worth it.
: Think about it, though! Isn't sex just...the best form of exercise?! It works out all of your muscles and is great for cardio and...well...it just feels really good!
: Does it? Because I recall you having a bit of a tough time when we-
: That is a problem for future Ayane! Present Ayane has been horny ever since she woke up and needs your help to...not feel that way anymore!
: Present Ayane also needs to stop yelling before the others find out that we're already doing that sort of thing.
: It's not already, Sensei...
: Do you have any idea how long I had to just fantasize about doing those sorts of things with you before they actually started happening?
: I'm young, you know. Those fantasies took up a sizable portion of my life so far.
: Then why risk putting a premature end to them by doing something like this in the middle of gym when we have virtually no privacy at all?
: The only premature end I want is your semen inside of my vagina.
: I am leaving now.
: No! That one was good!
: You have a strange idea of what constitutes funny.
: I'm hilarious and you know it!
: You're going to need a little more than third rate humor to convince me to fuck you during gym class.
: You mean like this?...
: Is this convincing enough for you, Sensei?
: Ayane, why bother keeping tricks like that up your sleeve when you'd be better off employing them from the get-go?
: Why bother keeping your penis inside of your pants when it belongs inside of me?
Ayane not-so-discreetly begins rubbing herself through her bloomers, forcing me to stand directly in front of her so no one else can see.
: Ahh...Sensei...do me right here...my legs are too weak to make it to the storage room anymore...
: You are absolutely insane.
: Does the storage room door lock?
: Yes. I made sure of it.
: You're worryingly good at this.
Of course, there’s no way I can deny Ayane at this point.
Granted, I was having a hard enough time denying her in the first place. But the whole fingering herself in the middle of the room thing kind of pushed me over the edge.
: No one will notice, Sensei...I promise...
: How can you promise something like that? It doesn't make sense.
: It makes perfect sense.
: It really-
: Jeez! What else do I have to say to get you into that room?!
: I've been touching myself for like a full minute now and if anyone looks over here, they’re going to see me putting on a show for you and we’ll have to come clean about our secret love!
: I...don't know if that's what I'd call this-
: Just take me into the storage room and have sex with me already! I've been waiting all morning for this!
: Ayane-
: I am literally begging you!
: Sensei!
: Okay. But you need to make sure you stay completely quiet. Because if anyone else even catches wind of this, we won't be able to see each other anymore.
And I likely won't be able to see anyone anymore.
: I can do that...
: If anyone knocks on the door, we can just tell them we're...cleaning up or something.
: I just really, really, really, really, want you right now.
: You have made that extremely apparent.
: Like, really, really, really, really, really, really, really-
: I get it, Ayane.
: Really, really, really, really-
: Okay. Come with me.
: Oh, I will. Don't you worry about that.
I take Ayane's wrist and drag her into the storage room as quickly as I can to avoid the detection of the others.
It's one thing doing things like this in the comfort of her dorm room, but the idea of having sex with her with the entire class right outside is-
Well, actually, it's extremely hot.
But it's also extremely dangerous.
I guess this is just one of those nothing ventured, nothing gained situations, though.
And if Ayane is going to literally beg me to fuck her, I'm going to do just that.
For the reasons not to vastly underweigh the reasons that tempt me-
And there are few things in life that tempt me more than a desperately vulnerable girl.
: You're sure nobody saw us, right? Because you pulled me pretty urgently just now and I don't know if I'd be able to explain things away with my cleaning excuse after that.
: I'm pretty sure, but forgive me if I managed to get that wrong on account of the distraction I was dealing with.
: Distraction? Oh, you must be referring to my beauty.
: And the fact that you were masturbating in the middle of the gym, yes.
: Did watching me masturbate get you hard, Sensei?
: I was hard before that happened but it definitely made things worse.
: Why would you make me wait so long if you were already hard?! That's not fair!
: I don't know, Ayane. But if we're going to do this, I'm going to need you to do something for me first.
: Okay, fine. You can choose the position. What do you want?
: Doggystyle?
: Piledriver?
: Backwards spider crawl?
: I was actually-
: Wait, what was that last one?
: I don’t know. I made it up. It sounds fun though and we should try it.
: Right. Well anyway, I want a little more than just the choice of position.
: A...costume, then? I can probably run to the drama club room and see if-
: I want you to call me a...specific name.
: A name? What do you-
: Wait, like a master name?! So I’ll be your pet? Slave? Servant?
: You can be whatever you want to be.
: Just...make sure to call me-
